We need produce final answer in English. Need analyze docs thoroughly. Need summarize current findings and list open hypotheses in order of cheapness to test. Need be specific and thorough.

We need infer current state from docs. Project: GPU benchmarking llama.cpp-family engines on dual P100 for Qwen3.8-27B. Engines: pflash, buun, ik, mainline (PR #27342). Fixed params. Hypotheses H1-H12. Current findings: H5 partly confirmed worse: NCCL fails outright in ik graph, aborts; rebuild with NCCL off needed. H8: DFlash2 runs on mainline dual GPU, load check 16.10 t/s, 57% acceptance, clean output, not benchmark; dual-GPU works; v2 verified; forks can't do v2; mainline no tree verify restriction. H11 refuted: drafter placement doesn't matter; -devd CUDA0 aborts with DFlash2 due upstream bug; H9 evidence Q8 accepted less than Q4 (44.4 vs 45.8) for +0.87 GiB. H10 untested but cheap: P2P and AllReduce env vars; row may hit NCCL failure. H7 cheap: asymmetric turbo KV abort check. H2 maybe moderate: XL split-stall with telemetry. H3 quality comparison needs perplexity/coherence, confounded, more expensive. H4 KV sweep moderate. H1 MTP requires Phase 2 server/web? llama-bench can't drive speculative decoding, so more expensive. H6 blocked by H5 for graph; none/layer can proceed. H9 untested but no longer
